blocks.text: Group 2 elements and their compounds are obtained from abundant natural sources. Two important processes are the extraction of magnesium from seawater (the Dow process) and the production of quicklime from limestone.

blocks.prompt: Name the source used in the Dow process.
blocks.explanation: Seawater, which contains Mg2+ ions at low concentration.

items: Mg from seawater (Dow process); CaO from limestone (lime kiln).
